definitions.gloss: PASMO, a rechargeable IC card for trains and buses
definitions.explanation: A prepaid IC card used on trains and buses in the Tokyo area, issued by private railways and bus companies. You touch it on the ticket gate and can also pay in many shops. It works interchangeably with Suica.

examples.japanese: PASMO⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦チャージ→チャージ：09729_chaaji⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、PASMO⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧Suica⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{乗|の}れる→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: In Tokyo, if you have a PASMO or a Suica, you can ride both trains and buses.

notes:
Issued mainly by private railways, Tokyo Metro and bus companies, while Suica is issued by JR East. For the passenger the two cards do the same job, and most people simply use whichever they got first.
